Set up two-step login

One-time setup. From now on, logging in needs your password and a code from your phone, so a leaked password alone can’t get in.

  1. Open an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy, 1Password and others all work).
  2. Add an account and scan this code:
    Can’t scan? Choose “enter a setup key” and type:
  3. Type the 6-digit code the app shows:

This screen expires in 10 minutes. Lost your phone later? Change DASHBOARD_PASSWORD in Cloudflare. That resets two-step login so you can set it up again.

Connection

Ko-fi

Checking

How to connect Ko-fi
  1. On your Ko-fi (ko-fi.com/dismeigh), go to Settings → More → API.
  2. Paste this as the Webhook URL:
  3. Copy the Verification Token from that page into the Cloudflare secret KOFI_VERIFICATION_TOKEN, then redeploy.
  4. Use Ko-fi’s “Send Test” button. “Last payment received” should update.

The site only keeps each payment’s amount, type and time. Names, emails and messages are never stored.

        How do I…

        Help

        Getting around

        What's on each tab?

        Overview: the Today card (next stream, what’s waiting on you), today's numbers, site health, activity, where visitors come from and what they search. Ko-fi goal: your goal bar and past goals. Content: bounties, quotes, lore, verdicts, crew, rates, Work FAQ, pinned clip, Clip of the Month votes, YouTube row and special event. Ship's Log: answer Ask the Captain questions and moderate log entries. Arcade: scores, targets and weekly resets. Clients: quote requests, collab requests, client reviews, commissions and collab settings (including open nights), jobs, auditions, calendar and income. Streams: pre-stream checklist, death counter, go-live alerts, your stream schedule (repeats, skipped nights, one-time streams), the schedule graphic, OBS overlays and the QR code (with booth mode). Notes: private notes. Alerts: phone notifications. Site: banner, right-now line, maintenance mode and site look. Security & backups: your devices, backup codes, login history, link check and site backups.

        Can I use this on my phone?

        Yes. Open the dashboard in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. It works like an app, and phone alerts only work from the home-screen app on iPhone.

        Stream & site

        Put a message across every page

        Site tab, Site banner. Type a message, add a link if you want, and tap Show banner. Use the one-tap buttons for common ones like Live now or No stream tonight. Set Start at to schedule one for later.

        Change what's on the site (bounties, quotes, lore…)

        Content tab. Pick a section, edit, then tap Save at the bottom. Changes are live right away.

        Set up a Ko-fi goal

        Ko-fi goal tab. Fill in the name, amount and description, pick where it shows, and switch it on. When it’s done, End goal & save it moves it to the Funded list.

        Plan a subathon or special stream

        Content tab, Special event. Set the name, times, an optional goal and a run of show. The event page and the home page countdown update on their own.

        Ask a client for files and info

        Clients tab, open the job, then Agreement, client link, invoice & payments. Under “What you need from them”, type one item per line and Save list. It shows on their client page as a checklist. Each time they tick something, you get an alert, and the job shows “Waiting on client: 2 of 3”.

        Show open collab nights

        Clients tab, Collabs. Tick the nights of the week you’re open and add a time if you like. The press kit page lists the next open dates (3 weeks ahead). Tap a date in the dashboard to mark it taken, then Save. Streamers can pick a night in the request form.

        Update the game backlog

        Content tab, Game backlog. Add games as Playing now, Up next, Beaten or Dropped. It shows on the Shelf page above your Verdicts.

        Set up the Gear page

        Content tab, Gear. Add your mic, camera, PC, VTuber setup and so on, pick a section for each, and save. The page stays hidden from visitors (it shows a “page not found”) until you tick “Show the Gear page on the site”. While it’s off, use the Preview link under the switch to see it with what you’ve saved. Once it’s on, a Gear link shows in every page footer.

        Use the death counter

        Streams tab, Death counter. Type the game and tap Start counting. Tap +1 when you die (or press the + key while the card is on screen); − fixes a mistake. Add the Death counter overlay in OBS (Streams tab, Stream overlays), and tick the box to show it on the home page too. New game saves the old count in Past runs; End run hides it everywhere.

        Add overlays to OBS

        Streams tab, Stream overlays. Copy a link and add it in OBS as a Browser source at the size shown.

        Close the site for a bit

        Site tab, Maintenance mode. Visitors see a back-soon page. This dashboard, Ko-fi and client links keep working.

        Business

        Change my rates or open/close commissions

        Rates: Content tab, Rates. Open/closed: Clients tab, Commissions, with a separate switch and note for voice, websites and Discord. Set Spots there too, and the Work page shows spots left and closes itself when you’re full.

        Someone sent a quote request. Now what?

        Clients tab. Email them (button on the request), then Mark replied. If it turns into work, tap Make it a job. Requests delete themselves after 90 days unless you keep them.

        How do client reviews work?

        Turn on the client’s status page link for a job. Once you set the job to Done, that page asks them for a star rating and a few words (no links allowed). You get an alert, then approve, hide or delete it in Clients → Client reviews. Only approved reviews show in “What clients say” on the Work page. If they edit it later, it waits for your OK again.

        Send a client an agreement, invoice or status page

        Clients tab, open the job, then Agreement, client link, invoice & payments. Fill in each part, save, and use the Copy link buttons. Turn any link off at any time.

        Record money and see profit

        On the job, Record payment for anything paid outside Ko-fi (Ko-fi counts on its own). Add costs under Income, Expenses. Download spreadsheet gives you everything for tax time.

        Change the stream schedule

        Streams tab. Add your regular streams once with “Every week” and the days. To cancel one night, pick the date under “Skip a date” on that stream. For a one-off, add a one-time stream. The home page, calendar subscriptions and Rewind all update on their own.

        Log a stream’s stats

        Streams tab, Stream stats, “Log a stream”. Open Twitch’s stream summary email, select all, copy, paste it in the box and tap “Read the numbers”. Check them and Save. You can also type them in yourself. If a stream sets a new best peak, average or follower count, you get a one-tap “New record” banner for the site. Under the chart, “Best time to stream” shows which days and start times get the most viewers.

        Tell viewers I’m live

        Streams tab, Go-live alerts. Viewers who tapped “Notify me when Dismeigh goes live” on the home page get a notification. With “Send it automatically” on, it goes out by itself a few minutes after you start (once per stream). Or tap “I’m live: notify viewers” to send it right away.

        Post this week’s schedule

        Streams tab, Schedule graphic. Pick the week and the size (square for X or Discord, story for Instagram), then Download or Share.

        Post a site update or a car meet

        Content tab. “What’s new” adds a post to the What’s new page, and visitors get a small dot in the menu until they see it (it goes away on its own after 2 weeks). “Car meets” shows upcoming meets on the Garage page; past ones disappear the day after.

        Dyno sheet, track spotlight and booth mode

        Content tab: “Dyno sheet” fills the numbers card on the Garage page, and “Track spotlight” picks the Xssy track on the home page (paste a YouTube, Spotify or SoundCloud link). Booth mode lives in the Streams tab, in the QR code card: pick the clips, then Open booth mode on the tablet or laptop at your table.

        Answer a viewer’s question

        Ship’s Log tab, Questions. Type your answer and tap “Answer and post”. It shows on the Ask the Captain page right away. Delete the ones you don’t want to answer.

        Track voice auditions

        Clients tab, Auditions. Add each one with its deadline and change the status as you hear back. Deadlines show on the calendar.

        Safety

        I lost my phone

        On the login screen, tap Lost your phone? Use a backup code. Each code works once. Make a set in the Security & backups tab ahead of time. Out of codes? Change DASHBOARD_PASSWORD in Cloudflare, which signs everyone out and resets two-step login.

        Back everything up

        Security & backups tab, Backup and restore, then Download backup. Do it every month or so. Restoring keeps a copy of how things were right before, just in case.

        Something looks broken

        Overview tab, Site health shows what's down. Security & backups tab, Link check finds dead links. Turn on Something on the site breaks in Alerts to get pinged.

        Someone posted something nasty in the Ship's Log

        Ship's Log tab. Hide it or delete it. The site already blocks links and slurs.

        Nothing matches. Try another word.

        Phones and computers that have logged in

        Your devices

        A login from a device that isn’t on this list pings your phone (Alerts tab, failed logins switch). Sign out everywhere logs out every other device at once; you stay in here.

        If you lose your phone

        Backup codes

        Loading…

        Each code works once, in place of the 6-digit code. Keep them somewhere safe that isn’t your phone, like printed out or in a password manager. Using one pings your phone.

        Save these now. They won’t be shown again.

          Security

          Login history

          Logins and failed tries from the last 90 days. If you see one that wasn’t you, change DASHBOARD_PASSWORD in Cloudflare right away. That signs everyone out and resets two-step login.

          On your phone

          Install the dashboard

          Add the dashboard to your home screen to use it like an app. On iPhone: Share → Add to Home Screen. On Android: the menu → Install app.

          Housekeeping

          Link check

          Tests every outside link on the site and in your content (lore, pinned clip, event, banners). Some sites, like Instagram or TikTok, block checkers, so those show as “couldn’t check”.

          Just in case

          Backup and restore

          One file with everything you’ve typed in here: content, site settings, Ko-fi goals, arcade targets, notes, client jobs and Ship’s Log entries. No passwords, login codes or visitor info.
